chapter: Drumming days and neighborhood life, 1919 onward
title: Why he gave up drums: carrying a set in the 1920s
summary: Ernie loved drums but hauled a set by streetcar with a city-hall permit, and rides were hard to get. As a boy he went to jobs his brother passed to him.
